5. After crafting the 16 rails, I will have 1 iron ingot left over, which I can use to craft the remaining 6 detector rails.
6. With all the necessary materials gathered, I can now craft the 6 detector rails.
7. Finally, I can craft the detector rail using 6 detector rails.

3. Craft 6 detector rails.

3. Gather 1 stick, 6 iron ingots.
